name: 4DGS v1 Progressive Loader
definition: A progressive loading strategy for volumetric splat files (`.4dsplat` v1) that streams independent gaussian blocks per timestep, allowing the viewer to re-upload textures on every timestep change.
summary: The 4DGS v1 Progressive Loader streams volumetric splat files by loading independent Gaussian blocks per timestep, treating each frame as a self-contained unit rather than interpolating continuous data.
